title: File Header Generator Configuration
description: Per-project configuration for the file-header generator: the ASCII logo banner, project name, and target width. See src/utils/developer-tooling/file-header-generator/types.ts (IHeaderConfig).

projectName.description: Human-readable project name shown in the header

width.description: Total character width of the rendered header

banner.description: ASCII banner lines rendered at the top of the header; re-centered by the generator

bannerFont.description: Optional figlet font used to render the banner (or "custom" for hand-made art)
